payload.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
payload.body:
## Pull request overview This PR makes string → `Scalar` conversions explicit by removing `From<&str>`, `From`, and `From<&String>` bounds from the `Scalar` trait and replacing them with an explicit `Scalar::from_str_via_hash(&str)` API, then updating call sites to name the hashing step directly. **Changes:** - Introduce `Scalar::from_str_via_hash` (defaulting to `ScalarExt::from_byte_slice_via_hash(val.as_bytes())`) and remove string `From` bounds from `Scalar`. - Update decoding, inner-product, column conversion, and bench utilities to call `from_str_via_hash` explicitly for `VarChar`. - Add tests verifying string hashing behavior (including multibyte UTF-8 and empty string). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/scalar/scalar.rs | Removes string `From` bounds from `Scalar` and adds `from_str_via_hash` with a default implementation. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/scalar/scalar_ext.rs | Adds tests validating `from_str_via_hash` behavior and its equivalence to hashing UTF-8 bytes. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/sql/proof/provable_query_result.rs | Makes `VarChar` decoding explicit by decoding `&str` then hashing via `S::from_str_via_hash`. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/slice_ops/inner_product.rs | Adds `inner_product_with_strings` mirroring the existing byte-hashing inner product helper. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/database/owned_column.rs | Switches `VarChar` inner product evaluation to `inner_product_with_strings`. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/database/column.rs | Updates `VarChar` scalar materialization to use `S::from_str_via_hash`. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/database/literal_value.rs | Updates `LiteralValue::VarChar` → scalar conversion to use `S::from_str_via_hash`. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/database/table_utility.rs | Updates varchar helper construction to hash strings explicitly via `from_str_via_hash`. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/database/owned_table_test_accessor.rs | Updates `VarChar` accessor scalar allocation to call `from_str_via_hash` explicitly. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/commitment/committable_column.rs | Updates varchar commitment conversion to use `S::from_str_via_hash`. | | crates/proof-of-sql/src/base/arrow/arrow_array_to_column_conversion.rs | Updates Arrow Utf8 → column conversion to hash strings explicitly via `from_str_via_hash`. | | crates/proof-of-sql-benches/src/utils/random_util.rs | Updates random varchar/scalar/decimal column generation to use `S::from_str_via_hash`. |

payload.author: MyTH-zyxeon

Review-assist note for #228:

The direction looks aligned with the bounty, but I think the current patch still leaves the main opaque API surface in place. At head `9bedc3a`, `mont_scalar.rs` still exposes the old generic conversions alongside the new names:

- `impl_from_for_mont_scalar_for_string!(&str)` and `impl_from_for_mont_scalar_for_string!(String)` still hash strings through `From`.
- `impl<T: MontConfig<4>> From<[u64; 4]> for MontScalar<T>` still allows `MontScalar::from(limbs)` for the limb conversion.
- `impl<T: MontConfig<4>> From<MontScalar<T>> for [u64; 4]` and `impl<T: MontConfig<4>> From<&MontScalar<T>> for [u64; 4]` still allow `scalar.into()` for the reverse conversion.
- Serialization/deserialization in the same file still use those generic conversions (`self.into()` / `limbs.into()`).

So the new `from_limbs`, `to_limbs`, and `from_str_via_hash` methods are added, but downstream and in-tree callers can still use the exact opaque `From`/`Into` forms that #228 is trying to eliminate. I would treat this as the main acceptance gap: replace the remaining internal uses with the explicit methods, then remove or otherwise deprecate the old string/limb `From` impls so the explicit API is enforced rather than optional.
